mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM attributes a LEFT JOIN category_attributes ca ON a.id = ca.attr_id WHERE ca.category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY ca.sort ASC, a.sort ASC
SELECT a.* FROM attributes a LEFT JOIN category_attributes ca ON a.id = ca.attr_id WHERE ca.category_id = #{categoryId} AND a.attr_type = #{attrType} ORDER BY ca.sort ASC, a.sort ASC
SELECT a.* FROM attributes a WHERE a.id NOT IN ( SELECT ca.attr_id FROM category_attributes ca WHERE ca.category_id = #{categoryId} ) ORDER BY a.sort ASC, a.id ASC
